turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Sure! Let us look at one example together.
I work in an office. My mother works in an office.
Step 1: "My mother" is "she".
Step 2: "she" means the verb needs -s: works.
Rule: he, she or it + verb + s.
Right: He works on Saturdays. Wrong: He work on Saturdays.
Now you try one. Write only the verb:
Write the correct form: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
